Episode 56: Heart Attack
Keshav complains of chest pain and is admitted to the hospital. Koki fears Keshav had a heart attack. The nurse informs Koki that Keshav was murmuring Prema's name, which makes Koki upset. Will Prema pay a visit to Keshav in the hospital? Watch and find out.
